name: E_HEALTHCARE_PHI
description: Presence-based PHI. Branch A: clinical context (predefined Medical Information or Medical Document, or the custom clinical phrases) AND at least one strong identifier. Branch B: two distinct strong identifiers. Branch C: the legal-sex booster beside a strong identifier.
expression: ((((D:Medical Information > 0) OR (D:Medical Document > 0) OR (D:D_CLINICAL_PHRASES > 0)) AND ((D:D_MRN > 0) OR (D:D_ACCT > 0) OR (D:D_DOB > 0))) OR (((D:D_MRN > 0) AND (D:D_ACCT > 0)) OR ((D:D_MRN > 0) AND (D:D_DOB > 0)) OR ((D:D_ACCT > 0) AND (D:D_DOB > 0))) OR ((D:D_LEGAL_SEX > 0) AND ((D:D_MRN > 0) OR (D:D_ACCT > 0) OR (D:D_DOB > 0))))

name: E_PHI_BULK_EXPORT
description: Volume-based PHI for mass exposure: any strong identifier appearing 10 or more times in one transaction (a record dump or spreadsheet). Tune the threshold to your export sizes.
